description: Figure 7 is a grouped bar chart that displays the number of questions, out of a total of 40, where the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generated by GPT3 using different methods contained at least one factual error. The horizontal axis presents four distinct datasets: HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC. The vertical axis, labeled "Factual Errors," ranges from 0 to 40 in increments of 5. For each dataset, there are three bars representing the number of factual errors for three different methods: NoR QA (orange), OneR QA (red), and IRCoT QA (blue). The chart visually illustrates that NoR QA consistently results in the highest number of factual errors across all four datasets, with values of 15 (HotpotQA), 29 (2WikiMQA), 28 (MuSiQue), and 15 (IIRC). OneR QA shows a lower number of errors, with values of 10, 23, 27, and 14, respectively. IRCoT QA demonstrates the lowest number of factual errors, with values of 5, 14, 23, and 11. The caption indicates that this data supports the conclusion that IRCoT has fewer factual errors than OneR, which in turn has fewer than NoR.
